street_trees.source: City of Buffalo, Tree Inventory (Dept. of Public Works, Parks & Streets)
street_trees.granularity: one row per tree site with lat/lon
street_trees.data_as_of: current inventory on retrieval date (not December 2022)
street_trees.method: excluded VACANT, STUMP, STUMP OBSTRUCTED, unsuitable vacant; assigned to nearest neighborhood center within 1.5 km

medical_device_households.source: HHS emPOWER REST Service, Electricity Dependent DME - ALL - ZipLevel
medical_device_households.license: public HHS data (de-identified; no license stated)
medical_device_households.measure: Medicare FFS + Medicare Advantage beneficiaries with a claim for electricity-dependent DME (people, Medicare only; not households)
medical_device_households.data_as_of: current monthly release on retrieval date (not December 2022)
medical_device_households.method: ZIP counts split to 2020 census tracts by Census ZCTA-tract relationship file, weighted by ACS 2023 tract households x land-area share; summed over each neighborhood's tracts

overhead_line_share.note: no public data on overhead vs underground lines by neighborhood found
